why: The DEV-FLAG entry path, which has no setup pane: `initialVersusConfig` is null, so `createVersusLevelSystem` is never constructed and the pane stamp above is unreachable. This was a real gap rather than a hypothetical one -- it shipped in the first draft of #891 and was caught only by recording `?dev=1&mode=ffa&players=4&bots=4` with `--flag aiContact` and finding the overlay still empty. Measured after the fix: overlay-lit pixels went from 52 to 1,229 over 4 sampled frames.
killedBy: createLevelSystem stamps bot slots on the DEV-FLAG path, which has no setup pane (issue #891)
